get.summary: The category tree with active-product counts.
Filter facets (brands, price range, spec options) for a category.
Searches active products with text, brand, price, stock, spec filters, sorting and paging.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category slug; a parent category includes its descendants.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Free-text search over name, brand and description; partial trailing words match by prefix.

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Brand name. Repeat the parameter to accept several brands.

parameters.name: minPrice
parameters.description: Minimum price in USD (inclusive).

parameters.name: maxPrice
parameters.description: Maximum price in USD (inclusive).

parameters.name: inStock
parameters.description: When true, only products with stock available.

parameters.name: featured
parameters.description: When true, only featured products.

parameters.name: spec
parameters.description: Spec filter, repeatable; needs a leaf category. Number range 'ram_gb:16..64' (either bound optional), value list 'os:Windows 11,Linux', boolean 'anc:true'.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order: featured, relevance, priceAsc, priceDesc or newest. Defaults to relevance with text, otherwise featured.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: 1-based page number. Defaults to 1.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Page size, 1 to 48. Defaults to 24.

get.summary: Product detail with specs, option axes and variants.
The current basket with live prices and stock. Empty when there is no basket.

parameters.name: X-Requested-With
parameters.description: Must be "voltlane". Without it the API answers 400 request.missing_csrf_header.

put.summary: Sets a line's quantity (0 removes it). The first anonymous write issues the vl_basket cookie.

parameters.name: X-Requested-With
parameters.description: Must be "voltlane". Without it the API answers 400 request.missing_csrf_header.

delete.summary: Removes a line. Removing a line that is not there succeeds.

parameters.name: X-Requested-With
parameters.description: Must be "voltlane". Without it the API answers 400 request.missing_csrf_header.

post.summary: After sign-in: merges the vl_basket cookie's basket into the user's, deletes it and expires the cookie. Repeating it changes nothing. For the shared demo admin nothing is merged and the cookie is kept.

parameters.name: X-Requested-With
parameters.description: Must be "voltlane". Without it the API answers 400 request.missing_csrf_header.

post.summary: Places an order from the basket at live prices. Repeating a request with the same Idempotency-Key returns the same order. The client then polls the Location (checkout-status).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A GUID chosen by the client per checkout attempt; reuse it when retrying.

parameters.name: X-Requested-With
parameters.description: Must be "voltlane". Without it the API answers 400 request.missing_csrf_header.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: 1-based page number. Defaults to 1.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Page size, 1 to 50. Defaults to 10.

get.summary: One of the caller's orders with its lines, address, totals and status history.
Where one of the caller's checkouts stands. Poll while the state is Pending; ReadyToPay carries the payment URL.

post.summary: Reports the outcome chosen on the simulated payment page (test mode without Stripe). A payment that has already ended is left unchanged.

parameters.name: X-Requested-With
parameters.description: Must be "voltlane". Without it the API answers 400 request.missing_csrf_header.

post.summary: Creates an account and signs it in. The refresh token is set as an HttpOnly cookie.

parameters.name: X-Requested-With
parameters.description: Must be "voltlane". Without it the API answers 400 request.missing_csrf_header.

post.summary: Signs in with email and password.

parameters.name: X-Requested-With
parameters.description: Must be "voltlane". Without it the API answers 400 request.missing_csrf_header.

post.summary: Rotates the refresh cookie and returns a new access token. 204 when no refresh cookie was sent (no session); 401 when it is invalid, expired or reused. Replaying a rotated token revokes its family.

parameters.name: X-Requested-With
parameters.description: Must be "voltlane". Without it the API answers 400 request.missing_csrf_header.

post.summary: Revokes the refresh token family and always clears the cookie. Answers 409 when the revoke lost a concurrency race and should be retried.

parameters.name: X-Requested-With
parameters.description: Must be "voltlane". Without it the API answers 400 request.missing_csrf_header.

post.summary: Creates a throwaway demo customer and signs it in (rate limited per client IP).

parameters.name: X-Requested-With
parameters.description: Must be "voltlane". Without it the API answers 400 request.missing_csrf_header.

post.summary: Signs in the shared demo admin. 503 when the admin has not been seeded.

parameters.name: X-Requested-With
parameters.description: Must be "voltlane". Without it the API answers 400 request.missing_csrf_header.

expectedTotal.description: The total the shopper was shown, in USD. A different live total is refused with price_changed.

Bearer.description: Short-lived access token from the identity endpoints.
